stalls.summaryZh: 三代、約60年老攤，餛飩皮薄餡多、鹹湯圓肉餡紮實，雙拼吃法最受歡迎；座位少、常客滿。
stalls.summaryEn: Three-generation, ~60-year stall: thin-skinned wontons and hearty savory tangyuan, best ordered together. Few seats and often full.
